writeup: TIC 260844755 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 0.7191 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse causing a 5.57% dimming of the star's light, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 179.5 using the Box Least Squares algorithm. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the eclipse signature at the target location, with a peak signal-to-noise of 29.1 and a centroid offset of 2.7 arcsec from the target coordinates. No secondary eclipse was detected in the data. This object does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unknown candidate. The candidate passed all automated data quality checks without flags.
